title: red-pipeline and apply --push read a main pipeline whose gate jobs never ran as green
goal: backlog.py red-pipeline and querylog.py apply --push read a main pipeline by its gate jobs (kb-tests, kb-trailers), not by the pipeline status: a pipeline whose gate job is manual, skipped, canceled or failed under allow_failure is unverified, never green; red-pipeline --status exits 1 on it and says which job did not pass, and apply --push stops as for an unfinished pipeline; test_red_pipeline_unrun_gate_is_not_green proves it from recorded job lists

gates.question: Which jobs of a main pipeline must succeed for main to be green, and what do the other jobs and a failed script mean?
options: kb-tests and kb-trailers are the gate: green only when both succeeded; a job whose script ran and failed (failure_reason script_failure) makes the pipeline red whichever job it is (S1 for kb-tests, else S2), since every job is allow_failure; kb-tests-floor, tool-stress and kb-tests-windows never make it unverified when manual, skipped, canceled or failed without running
every job the pipeline has must succeed (kb-tests-windows waits on the project runner; tool-stress and kb-tests-windows exist only when their paths changed)
kb-tests, kb-trailers and kb-tests-windows when the pipeline has it; the rest as in the first option
gates.recommendation: kb-tests and kb-trailers are the gate: green only when both succeeded; a job whose script ran and failed (failure_reason script_failure) makes the pipeline red whichever job it is (S1 for kb-tests, else S2), since every job is allow_failure; kb-tests-floor, tool-stress and kb-tests-windows never make it unverified when manual, skipped, canceled or failed without running
gates.answer: kb-tests and kb-trailers are the gate: green only when both succeeded; a job whose script ran and failed (failure_reason script_failure) makes the pipeline red whichever job it is (S1 for kb-tests, else S2), since every job is allow_failure; kb-tests-floor, tool-stress and kb-tests-windows never make it unverified when manual, skipped, canceled or failed without running

notes: Pipeline 2892882880 of main reports success while kb-tests, kb-tests-floor, kb-trailers and tool-stress failed without starting and kb-tests-windows is manual: .gitlab-ci.yml makes every job manual with allow_failure: true, so the pipeline status is success whatever the jobs did.
